d:
掉入森林的诡谲陷阱
惊慌下失语的精灵
被无限生长的藤蔓拖住
繁花镶嵌的枝桠抚平伤疤，
心里塌陷的一块
冒出了新芽
彼之良·卡利亚【失语精灵/ULTRA妆/仿生2.2CF系列/155Mcm】

Falling into the enchanted traps of the forest.
The elf lost for words in panic,
is entwined by the endless vines.
Blossom adorned branches soothe the scars.
A piece of the heart where it collapsed,
now cradles a budding spark.
Bezlya Calla ElfAphasia, Bionic 2.2 CF series 155cm M ver
